BUILD/: plan.json as truth, PLAN.md and STATE.md generated, LEDGER.md and AMENDMENTS.md append-only
tools/gate.py: status, check, close, checkpoint, amend, ledger, render
CLAUDE.md at the repo root carrying the session rules

phases.title: Scope resolver
phases.intent: Five-layer resolution, deeper shadows shallower, overlays may only tighten. This is what makes 'an engagement can only see the skills its scope resolves to' true by construction rather than by policy.

phases.title: Graph compiler

phases.notes: Recipes, not a model, produce the plan until P26. Debugging plan compilation and a model's plan proposal at the same time means trusting neither.

phases.title: The assertion suites
phases.intent: The 25 invariants become tests that run in CI and before every execution, rather than properties of a picture that can be quietly wrong for months.

phases.notes: Two graphs, two suites. Conflating the 118-node architecture graph with the ~8-step plan graph is what made three assertions unsatisfiable in the blueprint's first draft.

phases.title: Step executor, idempotency, resume
phases.intent: A retry, a crash resume and a manual re-run after a fix are the same operation - and only the steps whose inputs actually changed are paid for twice.

Per-step timeout, one transport retry, then quarantine
A blocked run checkpoints and exits - no process, no lock, no context window held
exit: Killing a run mid-flight and resuming re-executes zero completed steps
A late result from a timed-out step cannot overwrite the retry that replaced it
A run blocked on a review item releases its lock and stops the wall-clock budget
Steps pass content-addressed refs, never values
phases.notes: The checkpoint-and-exit decision is what makes the '4h excluding time waiting on a human' budget honest.

phases.title: Context builder
phases.intent: Everything a model is shown is assembled in one place and recorded, so any call can be reconstructed exactly.

phases.title: Confidence router, review queue, decision log
phases.block: Block C - The harness around one step

Over the whole filing's text layer the check reports nothing, so a finding means something

phases.block: Reading what a client actually sends
phases.intent: Give each of the four an answer. Two are read - an .ods through the conversion seam that already exists, an .eml as the message it is, naming the attachments it carries because that is what somebody has to be sent instead. Two are refused by name with what to do, which is what being routed is for.
tasks: Convert an .ods to a workbook at the boundary, through the same seam a .csv goes through
Read an .eml as its message text, and name every attachment it carries in the diagnostic
Route .xlsb and .msg so each is refused by name with what to do about it
Keep an .ods out of the zip refusal in looks_like, which catches it on its first bytes

An .xlsb and a .msg are each refused with what they are and what to do, not decoded

phases.block: Reading what a client actually sends
phases.intent: Re-add the cash roll-forward the way footing re-adds a total: beginning plus the net change equals the ending, within one column, from figures the statement states itself. Nothing inferred and nothing compared across statements, because the one cross-statement comparison available here is wrong for a reason a reader has to know about.
tasks: Re-add beginning plus net change against the stated ending, per column
Check each column's beginning against the prior column's ending
Say nothing on a statement that does not state the three figures, as two_sides says nothing about an income statement
Record why the balance-sheet comparison is not made, with the figures that show it

checkpoints.title: Panels that earn their space

checkpoints.title: The interview can finish again
checkpoints.proves: The check CLAUDE.md names as what keeps a client's name inside knowledge/ answers honestly in all three states on the repo as it stands - refusing an empty register over real answers, passing on a clone nobody has been interviewed on, and scanning for real when there is something to scan - and the protocol, the map and the session that run it all still describe the same command.

checkpoints.title: Built, and wired to something
checkpoints.proves: The system the command assembles reads precedent into every context it builds, carries what a release gate is built from, and records a failure under the code it arrived with - each asked of the object build() returns rather than of a double, because a double would have been wired correctly by whoever wrote it.

checkpoints.title: The register, fillable
checkpoints.proves: A name enters the register because a person put it there, and a person is given what they need to do it: what in knowledge/ has the shape of a name and where it appeared, a command that adds one, and - for a session that named nobody, which the first three did - an acknowledgement that a person signed and that expires the moment another session is logged. No path lets the check pass without somebody having looked.

checkpoints.title: A machine that can be started
checkpoints.proves: A workflow can be approved from /admin by a named person with a recorded reason, through the board and into the governance chain, so a clean clone goes from nothing-will-run to something-will - and the register is still written by nothing but the board, still not committed, and still refuses a recipe edited since somebody read it.

checkpoints.title: What a person is told to type
checkpoints.proves: Every command the guide and the session rules give works from a fresh shell, the one tool that must not need the environment still does not, and a tool run without it names the command to type instead of raising somebody else's ImportError five hundred lines in.

checkpoints.title: A loop that can be entered
checkpoints.proves: A schema, provenance or tie-out rejection on a step whose recipe declares the matching region re-runs that step with the guard's own verdict in its context, masked with the run's identifiers by the one object that holds them - and nothing can name a region the recipe did not declare, substitute one loop for another, or raise a ceiling. The plan hash does not move and the blueprint needs no re-export, because the code caught up to what the design already said.

checkpoints.title: A run that ends says so
checkpoints.proves: Every quarantined step leaves exactly one record whatever ending produced it, a resumed pass over the same key does not write a second, and the three failure policies every recipe declares finally mean three different things - review tells a person, quarantine does not, halt ends the run through the one door that writes a manifest, which is the driver's and never the executor's.

checkpoints.title: The setup surface, used
checkpoints.proves: The two records a person creates during setup agree with each other and with the chain behind them: approving bytes that are already approved says who did and writes nothing, an edited file is still a second decision, neither register is committed, and the bar the profile form offers is one somebody chose rather than a default nobody did.

checkpoints.title: What a session is told, and whether it is still true
checkpoints.proves: Nothing in the open register asks a session to close a phase the plan says is closed, run a checkpoint that is green, or obtain a sign-off that exists; every settled row carries the date that settled it; and the documents a session is told to read all exist and point at each other.

checkpoints.title: Finding one client, and what the screen may claim
checkpoints.proves: The engagement fold and the runs panel are two readings of one set of rows and cannot disagree about which runs or how many are open; every state the page names or paints is one RunState can hold; and the register still carries the question that refusing to invent a valuation date opened.

checkpoints.title: The boundary, exercised rather than read
checkpoints.proves: A session walked end to end through the commands a person actually runs - status, session, answers, acknowledgement, scan - reports what the record holds at every point: the acknowledgement covers what it looked at and nothing logged after it, a standing one cannot be silently replaced, status and scan never describe the same file differently, a leaked identifier is named rather than raised on, and no command reaches the repository's own knowledge folder.

checkpoints.title: What version one gathers, and what it refuses to decide
checkpoints.proves: A repeat year rolls through all three pieces together - a ten-wide window dropping its oldest year, two dates moved on, last year's line items carried as this year's schema - and only what no arithmetic covers reaches a person; a request section never stands in for an item; a line-item mismatch is handed over rather than resolved; the sections are not a second document-type vocabulary; a skill's judgement is still routed on its confidence; and the fact that nothing yet sets the acceptance rule's evidence is recorded rather than quiet.

checkpoints.title: The gate reports a failure rather than becoming one
checkpoints.proves: A real check that fails with output the console cannot encode is still reported, as a failure, with its text intact and the unencodable character replaced; the gate runs as a process under that console encoding without a traceback; a passing check still reads as passing; and no phase sits past the last checkpoint.

checkpoints.title: An unwired seam is a decision, and the decision is on the record
checkpoints.proves: The scan is quiet on the tree as it stands, so a failure means something new; every excused seam names a backlog item that exists and does not claim to be built; the two found today are resolved the two different ways they warranted - one deleted because there was nothing to record, one kept because there was; and the earlier findings of the same shape, P55's precedent wiring and P60's on_failure, are still wired.

checkpoints.title: The retry path, joined at both ends
checkpoints.proves: The class the adapter raises is the class the executor catches and it belongs to the port so both can see it; something in production raises it, checked the way the gap was found; the executor's retry loop, its event and its exhaustion code are all still there; transient and permanent remain different questions; and the fact that no rehearsal could have caught this - the fake and scripted adapters have no network - is recorded where somebody trusting a clean rehearsal will meet it.

checkpoints.title: Two scans for one defect, and the shape they share
checkpoints.proves: Both scans are quiet on the tree, so a failure means something new; neither has stopped finding anything to look at; every excuse in either carries a reason; the two never excuse the same thing, which would let a defect hide behind whichever was read first; and the findings that paid for the scans - P55's precedent wiring, P60's on_failure, P72's retry - are all still fixed.

checkpoints.title: The scan is read here, and read before anything masks it
checkpoints.proves: Nothing on the OCR path can reach a model - not the port, not the adapters, not the document reader that calls them - and privacy/ is still deterministic Python; the eighth port is chosen by configuration and refuses an unknown name like the other seven; a machine with no engine reads everything it always could and still reports a scan rather than reading it as an empty page; and the adapter the analyst confirmed he can install is registered and buildable without it, so a clone, a container and the work laptop are the same code with different configuration.

checkpoints.title: Two engines, one real document, and a rule widened on purpose
checkpoints.proves: Every registered OCR engine is local, reaches no model and no network, and can be built on a machine that has installed none of them; none of them silently falls back to another, so a scan is never read by an engine nobody chose; the real filing is still read and the comparative-column defect it found is pinned along with the escalation that is the only thing stopping a run on it; and widening the fixtures rule to allow a public document did not loosen what it always forbade - no client data, a named public source, and the identifier register checking the fixture like anything else.

checkpoints.title: The documents a person arrives at, agreeing with each other
checkpoints.proves: CLAUDE.md, the interview protocol, the using guide, the handoff packet and .env.example still say the same thing about how to run it, about the setting that decides whether a scanned page can be read, and about what version 1 is for; every adapter they name is one the ports actually register; the shared vocabulary the protocol guard stands on survived the rewrite; and every document a session is sent to read still exists.

checkpoints.title: One design language, still one

checkpoints.title: A figure can be found again

checkpoints.title: What reaches a model, and what covers a figure

checkpoints.title: One reader, two kinds of page

checkpoints.title: What a run says it did with a file

checkpoints.proves: Every format the routing table lists is read or refused by name, no reader lets a library exception out, every figure that reaches the parse store carries a locator that resolves, and a token that is not a number is reported rather than dropped or repaired.
